maintenance_led.reason: Sells marketing services and SaaS subscriptions to small businesses, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private local service businesses paying for marketing services and software subscriptions.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling marketing services and SaaS to small businesses; acquisitions like Sensis were occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Small-business marketing services and CRM tools can be replaced by other marketing vendors without regulatory or major operational disruption.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call, since the CRM and software platform has some switching cost.
